newsitem.title: USA: US stocks strong in late trade but off day's highs.
newsitem.headline: US stocks strong in late trade but off day's highs.

text.p: U.S. stocks were strong in very heavy late trading but off session highs.

"The market is pretty heady now and getting narrower. There are fewer stocks leading the surge. The S&P 500 is not keeping pace with the Dow either," said Harvey Hirshhorn, Stein Roe chief economist and investment strategist. "There are a lot of momentum players trying to possition themselves and buying large, liquid names."
The Dow industrials rose 40 to 6458, still headed for a record but off the day's best levels of 6466.55. IBM again led the charge, up 4-1/8 to 158.
Technology stocks overall were solidly higher with the Nasdaq Composite up 14 to 1272.
Winners beat losers 14-9 on NYSE volume of 445 million shares.
